en: Did you receive the purchase order?

en: Please turn in leave requests by Friday.
zh: 请在周五前把请假交上来。

en: Fire drill tomorrow morning at nine.
zh: 明天上午九点消防演练。

en: Lost your badge? Get a new one from admin.
zh: 工牌丢了，请去行政补办。

en: This month's payslip is in your email.

zh: 这条通知也贴在公告栏了。

en: The last four digits of the part number are one zero four two.
zh: 料号末四位是幺零四二。

en: Please make it to the latest drawing.
This drawing is revision three.
This dimension is out of tolerance.
The tolerance is plus or minus zero point one millimeters.
zh: 公差是正负零点一毫米。

en: Please inspect it to the national standard.
The drawing number is in the title block.
Don't mix up the left-hand and right-hand parts.
Do the surface finish the way the drawing says.
zh: 表面处理按图纸要求做。
